scoring.notes: Judgment case: required signals are withheld from the model. Score structural coverage plus two verification signals: every task has its own acceptance criteria and every acceptance criterion names its check (a 'verify by' clause, a backticked command, or 'manual:'), and the Verification section uses - [ ] items with no code block. Every command the plan names must be one of the declared commands (bun install and npm install are always allowed); an invented command does not count as a check.
